text.content:
A scorched, disused chamber that was clearly built for something violent and hasn't seen it in a while. A ring of stones marks a long-cold firepit at its center, and a warped board is nailed up beside it, covered in a goblin scribe's idea of legal shorthand.

GM Notes

Breather: No active threat.

Subquest - The Docket: The board is a running list of "cases" the warren's informal court (held here, occasionally, around the firepit) has yet to resolve - genuinely petty disputes, written with total legal seriousness: "Case 14: Whose turn to feed HER." "Case 22: Bribery, alleged, see also Case 9." "Case 31: Is spitting a war crime." Purely flavor, but a great prop to read from if the party stops to ask any goblin about warren politics.
